prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Secure Your Pet Profile", "Your pet customization, memories, and progress automatically sync with your account.", "Cloud Auto-Sync Active & Secure"]
1: ["Review Your Companion's Look", "Check your pet's generated 3D render and expressions before completing adoption.", "Live Animation & Expression Check"]
2: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion!", "Try the interactive controls below to learn how to interact with your pet on desktop.", "Practice Controls: Single-Click (Select) | Drag (Move) | Double-Click (Chat)"]
3: ["Verifying multi-monitor support and window overlay permissions for desktop launch...", "Desktop Window Compatibility Check"]
4: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos for Best Results", "Use well-lit, front-facing photos so our engine can generate your desktop pet accurately.", "Select Clear Front-Facing Photos"]
5: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt", "Select an instant ready-to-play pet companion or build a custom pet from your photos.", "Instant Pet (1 min) vs Custom AI Pet (3 mins)"]
6: ["Sign In to Guarantee Pet Cloud Backup", "Linking your account ensures your pet's items, personality, and data remain safe even if you switch computers.", "Returning user? Sign in with your registered account to instantly recover your pet."]
7: ["Desktop Pet Controls & Shortcuts", "Quick reference for managing your companion while you work.", "System Tray (Hide/Show) | Alt+P (Summon Pet) | Right Click (Open Pet Menu)"]
8: ["Configuring companion 3D desktop overlays and loading behavior engines..."]
9: ["Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Adopt a lively pet that lives on your screen, reacts to your daily work, and keeps you company."]
